The woman wears glasses and a black shirt, pointing towards the camera with an open mouth as if speaking. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a tortoiseshell cat licking its nose, followed by a white spray bottle with a persimmon graphic. A hand is seen spraying the liquid into a room corner, a cat litter box, and a white plastic trash can. A white cat watches the hand closely. (3) A different white spray bottle is presented. A tortoiseshell cat lies on a brown bed. A hand sprays the mattress and wipes it with a white paper towel. The male character reappears, holding the bottle and gesturing enthusiastically with his hands while the woman smiles in the background. (4) A package of wet wipes is shown. Hands use a wipe to clean food residue off a wooden table and then wipe the inside of a yellow plastic litter box. The man and woman reappear, both giving thumbs-up gestures with happy facial expressions. (5) A white and grey cat is shown sleeping peacefully on a yellow cushion. The couple then holds up a spiral-bound desk calendar, flipping through pages featuring colorful illustrations of cats in various cartoonish store settings like a gym and a takoyaki shop. The video concludes with them pointing at a link overlay before a solid pink screen with a white logo appears.
